user.title: Add a WattLedger device
user.description: The ESPHome device running the wattledger component. Its energy history is imported into statistics for the Energy dashboard.

data_description.host: Host name or IP address of the device, e.g. vue-grid.local.
data_description.port: Port of the device's web server; 80 unless you changed it.

error.cannot_connect: Can't reach the WattLedger history API on this device. Check the address and that the firmware includes the wattledger component.
error.no_journal: The device answers, but its journal isn't available. Check its log for partition errors.

abort.already_configured: This device is already added; its address has been updated.
